text: The assigned patch removes the same expired Spring25 entry from all three branding data sets. The checked offline loader returns the JSON data and caches its IDs; it does not itself filter dates. Normal eligibility filtering rejects invalid dates, future starts and past ends, but its explicit bypass returns earlier after the interacted-ID guard. The selected offline data test checks shape and future end dates except a named test-only entry. Data removal, loading, eligibility and display are separate contracts; no notification fetch, clock-dependent test or display ran.
title: Bundled notification cleanup is separate from raw loading and normal expiry filtering
